rationale: The Court is most likely to resolve on narrow jurisdiction/relief grounds: §1252(a)(2)(A) and §1252(e) (reinforced by §1252(e)(3)) foreclose district-court programmatic injunctions that would supervise §1225/expedited-removal screening, without embracing a broad merits holding on asylum access. Roberts is best positioned to hold the coalition with a minimalist, text-and-structure opinion, while Gorsuch/Thomas remain plausible authors if the majority opts for a more categorical textualist preclusion rationale.
